  requires (n >= 1)
  requires (m >= 1)
  requires (p >= 2)
  requires (len(f) == n)
  requires (len(g) == m)

  requires forall k in 0..len(g): (g[k] > 0)

  requires exists k in 0..len(g): ((g[k] % p) != 0)

  effects pure
  example (solve(0, 0, 0, [], []) == 0)
